text: Evening. I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's 2. Her temperature was 39.8 about twenty minutes ago. I gave her Calpol at teatime and she perked right up, and in between doses she's been playing with her dolls, drinking her juice and chattering away same as ever. It creeps back up as it wears off. Her mum's away till tomorrow, so I thought I'd check with you what I should be keeping an eye on overnight. Thank you.
